questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to extend multi-account Terraform setups, manage backends, provider aliases, and CI gating across environments; ensures implementation of sandbox isolated from prod while sharing modules.

## Key Concepts
- Backend aliasing with per-env keys
- Provider aliasing and cross-account access (assume_role)
- Shared modules wired to specific providers
- CI gating via plan export to JSON and address filtering
- Safe apply gating with manual approval

## Code Example
```hcl
# sandbox backend config (sandbox.hcl)
bucket = "tf-state-prod"
key    = "envs/sandbox/terraform.tfstate"
region = "us-east-1"
dynamodb_table = "tf-locks"
```
```hcl
# sandbox provider wiring
provider "aws" {
  alias = "sandbox"
  region = "us-east-2"
  assume_role { role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/TfSandbox" }
}

module "network" {
  source = "./modules/network"
  providers = { aws = aws.sandbox }
}
```
```bash
# gating in CI
terraform init -backend-config=sandbox.hcl
terraform plan -out sandbox.plan
terraform show -json sandbox.plan > sandbox.json
jq -r '.planned_values.root_module.resources[].address' sandbox.json | grep -E 'prod|staging' -q && exit 1 || exit 0
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle drift between sandbox and prod if modules evolve?
- How would you audit who changed sandbox state and when?

## Code Example
```hcl
# modules/iam/main.tf
resource "aws_iam_role" "this" {
  name               = var.name
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "assume" {
  statement {
    effect = "Allow"
    principals {
      type        = "Service"
      identifiers = ["ec2.amazonaws.com"]
    }
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]
  }
}

# modules/bucket/main.tf
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "this" {
  bucket = var.bucket_name
}

# environments/dev/main.tf
module "iam" {
  source = "../../modules/iam"
  name   = "existing-role-name"
}

module "bucket" {
  source      = "../../modules/bucket"
  bucket_name = "existing-bucket-name"
}
```

## Minimal CI Gating Snippet
```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Run import and plan
export TF_VAR_name="existing-role-name"
export TF_VAR_bucket_name="existing-bucket-name"

terraform init -backend-config="key=envs/dev/terraform.tfstate"
terraform import module.iam.aws_iam_role.this arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/existing-role
terraform import module.bucket.aws_s3_bucket.this existing-bucket-name

# Verify no drift before allowing apply
terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan
if grep -q "No changes" plan.tfplan; then
    echo "Import verified - no drift detected"
    terraform apply plan.tfplan
else
    echo "ERROR: Drift detected after import. Review plan output."
    exit 1
fi
```
